parsed.scene_description: An indoor supermarket aisle with tall metal shelving stocked with packaged snacks and frozen goods. Decorative hot air balloon and red lantern ornaments hang from the ceiling. Bright fluorescent lights illuminate the space. A refrigerated display case is visible in the background near large windows.

objects.label: metal shelving unit
objects.observation: Multi-tiered gray metal shelving filled with various snack packages. Located on left and center of frame. Some shelves have wire baskets. Supported by vertical posts. Partially occludes products behind it.

objects.label: hot air balloon decorations
objects.observation: Yellow-and-white striped balloon hanging from ceiling near top right. Another green-and-white balloon visible left side. Suspended by thin wires. Not touching any surfaces. Appears to float above aisles.

objects.label: red lantern decoration
objects.observation: Red paper lantern hanging from ceiling on far right. Slightly out of focus. Attached by string to ceiling. Positioned above floor level. No contact with other objects.

objects.label: fluorescent light fixture
objects.observation: Long rectangular white light fixture mounted to black ceiling. Illuminates upper part of aisle. Positioned horizontally across top of frame. No visible supports except ceiling mount.

objects.label: refrigerated display case
objects.observation: Silver-colored glass-fronted cooler on far right. Located near window. Contains food items inside. Base rests on floor. Partially occluded by other objects.

objects.label: window
objects.observation: Large glass pane on right wall. Allows natural light into store. Framed by white trim. Behind refrigerated case. No visible obstruction.
